text: Bioinformatics is an interdisciplinary field that integrates biology, computer science, mathematics, and statistics. Its core lies in analyzing massive biological data (such as gene sequences, protein structures, gene expression profiles, etc.) through computational methods, to uncover the underlying biological laws and thereby solve problems in life sciences. In simple terms, it is a discipline of "interpreting the genetic code of life" and provides key tools and ideas for cracking disease mechanisms, drug development, and species evolution, among other areas.
